note: The fuzzed flow string is derived directly from the candidate bytes after the command selector byte.
Learn-action source subfields are validated against the current match before the action is accepted.
The safety obligation is that a subfield slice must stay within the field width; otherwise later reads can go past the valid bits.
The source-field check forwards the same subfield descriptor into the shared bounds checker.
The vulnerable path reaches the source-field validation used while parsing the learn action, where the malformed subfield can trigger the invalid read reported by MSAN.
